title: Cohort-aware model-versioning with changelog curation and automated impact blurbing
author: Evelyn Cho
release_notes:
Adds cohort-aware versioning metadata, an automated changelog composer that synthesizes human-friendly impact blurbs from perf deltas and telemetry, and migration tooling for existing model entries. No runtime breaking changes; backfills metadata and provides an opt-in rollout.
- Feature: cohort_version tag and cohorted-variant semantics
- Tooling: changelog composer (CLI + webhook) for auto-blurbs
- Migration: one-time metadata backfill with dry-run flag
body:
Summary:
This PR introduces cohort-aware versioning semantics in the model registry and a companion changelog curation system that auto-synthesizes short impact blurbs from performance profile deltas, telemetry, and sample prompts. The goal is to make releases more actionable for integrators: instead of raw metric dumps, the registry will publish concise, reviewer-friendly change blurbs and suggested rollout cohorts.

Motivation:
Operators and platform integrators increasingly ask for 'which customers are impacted' and 'what changed in plain language' when model variants are rolled out. Current release notes are produced manually from profile tables which is slow and error-prone. This PR automates the most common summarization patterns while preserving a handoff path for curators to edit blurbs before publication.

Design highlights:
- cohort_version metadata field: allows tagging a model version with a target cohort descriptor (e.g., default, beta, low-traffic, enterprise). Cohorts are free-form strings with recommended taxonomy documented in the registry README.
- changelog_composer service (lightweight): ingests a delta between two model profiles and telemetry snapshots; outputs: 1) one-line impact blurb, 2) short bullets (perf/latency/cost/quality directions), 3) suggested rollout cohort and risk flag. Composer uses heuristic rules + template driven text; deterministic templates ensure stable wording across runs.
- CLI/webhook: registry-admins can run 'mr changelog compose --from v1.2.3 --to v1.3.0 --dry-run' to preview blurbs. The webhook endpoint enables CI to attach composed blurbs to PRs or Linear tickets.
- Migration/backfill: a starter migration script scans existing versions and generates cohort suggestions (dry-run default). Backfill writes cohort_version only when a confidence threshold is met; otherwise leaves entries untouched for manual review.

Implementation notes:
- New DB column: models.cohort_version (varchar, nullable) + changelog_blurbs table to store composed drafts. Migration adds indexes for filtering by cohort.
- New API endpoints: POST /internal/models/:id/compose-changelog and GET /models/:id/changelog-draft. Endpoints respect auth and are gated by a feature flag 'cohort_changelog'.
- Composer logic lives in registry/services/changelog_composer.py with unit-tested rules. No changes to serving runtime.

Testing and quality:
- Unit tests added for templating, delta heuristics, and CLI parsing.
- Integration test (e2e) simulates two profile snapshots and verifies deterministic blurb output and webhook payload shape.
- Added property tests for the migration dry-run to ensure no DB writes.

Security and privacy:
- Composer never sends raw prompt content to external services — it only uses aggregated metrics and sanitized example tokens.

Deployment plan:
1) Merge to main behind feature flag 'cohort_changelog'.
2) Run migration in dry-run across the org for two days; surface candidates in a temp dashboard.
3) Enable backfill with conservative threshold during a weekday maintenance window.
4) Turn on webhook attachments for internal PRs, enable curated publication after early adopter feedback.

Commits (summary):
- add: cohort_version column + migration script
- add: changelog_composer core heuristics and templates
- add: CLI glue and webhook handler + tests
- feat: API endpoints and routing + feature flag gating
- test: unit + integration harness for composer
- docs: registry README additions and sample blurbs

Files changed (high-level):
- migrations/20251104_add_cohort_version.sql
- registry/services/changelog_composer.py
- registry/cli/compose_changelog.py
- registry/api/changelog_routes.py
- registry/tests/test_changelog_composer.py
- registry/migrations/backfill_cohort_dryrun.py
- docs/model_registry/cohorting.md
- templates/changelog/*.j2

Review timeline and discussion (chronological):
- Marcus Lee (reviewer): "Nice direction. Can you make the suggested cohort taxonomy configurable per-org? In our use-case enterprise cohorts map to different flags."
- Author (Evelyn): "Yes — added a small org_cohorts config lookup and default taxonomy in docs; the composer falls back to the global taxonomy if org-level not present."
- Priya Nair (reviewer): "Terrific, but the migration could accidentally touch large tables during peak. Add a throttling knob and a dry-run-only lock."
- Author: "Added backfill_cohort_dryrun.py and a backfill_rate_limit config; migration defaults to dry-run true. Also added an admin endpoint to resume with a rate cap."
- Owen McKenzie (reviewer): "Templates look stable but I want deterministic wording for audit logs. Please snapshot the template hash in changelog_blurbs."
- Author: "Added template_hash field and writing routine. Also added a unit test asserting stable output for the same hash and inputs."

CI notes:
- Build: python package lint and pytest/coverage
- Checks: db-migration-lint, schema-compatibility, black/isort, unit tests, integration e2e (slow).
- Initial run: one flaky integration failure on e2e (timeout), rerun succeeded. Final status: all green.

Merge notes:
- Merge method: squash and merge.
- Post-merge actions: run migration in dry-run on staging, enable feature flag in staging for tenant alpha, schedule production backfill on 2025-11-19.

Known limitations and follow-ups:
- Composer currently relies on simple heuristics; follow-up planned to add a small model-based summarizer (ENG-4215) for richer language if needed.
- Cohort taxonomy is advisory; future PR will add UI mapping for tenant owners to define custom cohorts.

Related work / references:
- Linear: ENG-4121 (cohort metadata), ENG-4215 (summarizer follow-up)
- Docs: registry/docs/cohorts.md (added)

If anything else is needed before merge I can add more integration tests for very large profile diffs.

Priya: Migration should throttle and default dry-run; avoid heavy table locks.
Evelyn: Added backfill_rate_limit and dry-run script plus admin resume endpoint.
Owen: Snapshot template hash in composer so blurbs are auditable.
